<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/reports/{id}/link"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



The single download endpoint. `id` is a run id from `/reports/catalog` (`runId`) or `/reports/history`. Returns a ~1h signed URL when the run is COMPLETED; 409 while PENDING/PROCESSING, 410 when it FAILED, 404 when the id does not exist in this workspace, 400 for a non-uuid id. Same plan-entitlement gate as `/reports/generate`, evaluated for the run’s own tax year.
